messages:
maya: CI is red on android-arm64 after yesterday's cmake/ng-ndk update. Failing in cross-compile include resolution, looks like headers not found for libnative.
alex: link to failing CI run?
maya: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/68291 - linux-docker-android/karma shard. Error snippet below.
ci-bot: build 68291 failing tests: //apps/mobile/native:libnative (FAILED)
sam: can we just rerun the job first? flake or env issue often.
maya: tried a rerun, same failure. Suspect CMake change that landed in toolchain image `toolchain-2026-02` (rolled yesterday).
helen: paste the error please (or small log). :eyes:
maya: ```
In file included from /workspace/apps/mobile/native/src/main.cc:12:
../../third_party/ndk/sysroot/usr/include/android/some_header.h:10:10: fatal error: 'utils/some_internal.h' file not found
 #include "utils/some_internal.h"
          ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
compilation terminated.
```
alex: hmm looks like include search paths lost `-I$(NDK)/sources` somehow.
sam: did the toolchain image change the sysroot layout? new ndk maybe moved headers under `platforms` vs `sysroot`.
john: @helen can you run a fast bisect across the toolchain images? we need to know which image bumped the layout.
helen: running quick bisect locally against our images now. command I'll run: `git bisect start HEAD toolchain-image@2026-01 && git bisect run ./scripts/build_docker_image_and_test.sh`.
helen: update: bisect narrowed it to toolchain image `toolchain-2026-02-ndk-r25` which added a symlink change. Repro locally with docker: `docker run --rm -v $PWD:/w toolchain-2026-02-ndk-r25 bash -lc "bazel build //apps/mobile/native:libnative"` fails.
maya: nice. Any workaround to unblock CI while we decide revert vs fix?
alex: patch in build flags to add explicit include: `-Ithird_party/ndk/sources/android/support` would unblock quick.
sam: or we can patch the image to recreate the symlink. Which is faster?
john: image revert needs approvals for infra deploy window. Patch build is quick, do that for now and open infra ticket.
helen: created PR to add fallback includes and a note to revert once infra fixes image: https://git.internal.redwood/p/mobile/PR-3372 :shipit:
maya: thanks, I'll queue rerun once PR lands.
ci-bot: pull request PR-3372 merged by he{
